points.message: Copper has metallic bonding in a giant lattice structure.
Copper contains delocalised electrons that are free to move.
Sodium chloride has ionic bonding in a giant lattice structure.
The ions in solid sodium chloride are in fixed positions and cannot move, so solid sodium chloride does not conduct electricity.
